description: Price a cart the way BringMeThat checkout will show it: item total, fees, tax, delivery or pickup, and the default tip. Does not charge a card, does not place an order, and does not create a link. Pass the same restaurant_id, fulfillment, and items you will pass to create_checkout_link. The quote is the guest total. The Premium checkbox keeps its default and is not changed by this tool. Checkout is the item total plus a 10% markup, the restaurant's own service fee (none for partner restaurants; there is no flat service fee), tax, a $7 delivery fee ($0 for pickup) unless a Habitat or MealMe delivery quote replaces it, and an optional tip. Premium ($9.95/month or $96/year) waives the markup and the service fee, but not delivery, tax, or tip. The card is authorized for that total plus $15 when the total is over $30, otherwise plus 45%. Only the final amount is charged.

delivery_address.description: Street address for delivery. Not required to quote.

options.description: Choices for the item's option groups. Use group_index and option names exactly as get_menu lists them. Required groups must be filled.
